publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4, build 4A102; original iPod reference and native PinePhone research
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.

record.title: Separate iPhone userspace reaches a physical home screen
record.method: Owner-confirmed M68AP interaction and post-run integrity checks
record.observation: The separate M68AP 4A102 research profile unlocked to its home screen, accepted Settings and Photos touch, and returned through clean reboot. Its root and the N45 reference volumes remained unchanged.
record.limits: This is a prepared local preservation profile, not a retail activation result or a complete iPhone port. No cellular service is established. This first home-screen run saved no screenshot; later screenshot and Camera records are separate milestones.

records.access: Private project record; only the selected excerpt is distributed

exhibits.title: Separate iPhone userspace reaches a physical home screen
rows: Home unlock; Settings and Photos touch
Clean bit set; read-only fsck exit 0
M68 root unchanged; N45 root/data and partition table unchanged
No cellular-service acceptance; no screenshot in this run
exhibits.interpretation: The second userspace profile adds app and integration questions without turning the iPod reference or the physical device into a fully supported phone.
